title: Fix the /themes colour-contrast failures axe reports at 390 and 1280 (9 nodes each)

source.ref: SCAN-1032 audit run 2026-11-09 against a production build of main 247fa6a2c; /themes

detail: Serious axe color-contrast on 9 nodes at both viewports (production build of main 247fa6a2c, 2026-11-09). Read audit-out/report.json for the node selectors, fix the token pairs in the Nocturne-structured theme page, no hardcoded hex. Done when: node scripts/audit/route-family-audit.mjs --routes /themes reports no finding of this kind. 2026-11-10 NODES (axe on the production build): nine inline-styled kit miniatures in the /themes hero clouds, each failing 4.5:1. Bold: #FFFFFF on #D4703E (3.39) on the 'See what's open' and 'Reserve' pills. Wildheart: #7D6D62 on #F5EEE2 (4.29) on the nav links, the lede, the 'New moon' caption and the tagline. The text is 1.4 to 7.6px in a miniature, but axe still counts it, and role=img and aria-hidden do NOT exempt it (tested). The failing pairs are the kits' own tokens, so the fix is a palette ruling for the owner: darken Wildheart muted (a step darker clears 4.5:1) and decide whether Bold's white-on-Fall accent button stays (the owner rule is white labels on accent buttons).

verify.evidence: OPEN. Re-run the audit on a production build and read report.md.
